crosswalks.historical_boundary: Ancient Engaruka 2,000 ha irrigation and settlement system shown in Westerberg et al. Figure 3
crosswalks.resolution_method: The named EU5 engeruka location is centered at 36.109 E, 3.049 S and its calibrated sample footprint fully contains the archaeological site at approximately 35.96 E, 2.99 S. No area weight is applied because this is validation-only.
crosswalks.notes: Exact named-site containment is resolved. Chronology, not mapping, is the reason this record cannot train.
